featured_reviews.review_text: Very bad service provider.  Please don't waste your time, money & peace of mind by calling them. My cctv was not working so I called them, the technician said the adapter & 1 more spare was not working, I got it changed from them, within 8 days I faced the same problem again. Now the new story is the DVR is old so the adapter spoiled.  When I asked why was this not told before, they had no answer, the adapter and the spare provided by them has no warranty so my money is in drain. They couldn't check the system properly and detect the fault, hence it's my problem again. SAMAL just cheats. Please be aware of them. If there was a star lesser than 1 it would have been apt for Samal & Sanjay Khemkar. Worst kind of people! Please be aware.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Ma'am, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Our goal is always a working system for our clients. When we replaced the adapter, the system was fully functional. Unfortunately, electronic components—especially older DVRs—can behave unpredictably if they are not kept in a cool, clean environment.
​The failure of the DVR 8 days later was not due to a wrong diagnosis, but due to the unit’s condition. We regret that the spare parts manufacturer does not provide a warranty for burnt items, which is why we could not offer a free replacement. We would value the opportunity to explain this technically in person and find a cost-effective solution for you."
